query: select pl_name,pl_masse,pl_masseerr1,pl_masseerr2,pl_masselim,pl_rade,pl_radeerr1,pl_radeerr2,pl_radelim,pl_bmassprov,pl_refname,default_flag,rv_flag,ttv_flag,tran_flag from ps where default_flag=1 and pl_masse between 0.25 and 10 and pl_rade>0 order by pl_masse
selection_status: approved teaching selection; not a population-complete or uniformly precise sample
selection: finite mass, radius, and asymmetric uncertainties; mass and radius limit flags 0; Mass provenance; positive upper and negative lower errors; positive lower interval endpoints for log plotting; 0.25 <= mass/Earth_mass <= 10
